title: Room to Breathe
briefing: Kestrel Air is trending up, but it wobbles a lot. Place your stop where the trend would be broken, not where a normal wobble reaches.
objective: Put stops beyond chart structure and outside the normal daily range. Raise them; never lower them.
debrief: Kestrel Air rose but swung about 2% on ordinary days. Stops placed a few cents below the entry were hit by normal wobbles, and the price then carried on up without those players. Stops below the last swing low survived. On day 24 a fuel-cost warning broke the trend: a stop raised under the most recent higher low got out with most of the gain.
